title: D13: extension integer keys limited to ±(2^53-1)
description: mimi-content-09 §4.3 CDDL types extension keys as int; §6.2 limits integer map keys to ±(2^53-1). Readings: (a) §6.2 applies to extension keys; (b) any CBOR int. Chosen: (a), the strict reading, consistent with §6.2's general rule for map keys; out-of-range keys rejected on decode (MapKeyOutOfRange) and encode.
